<!-- pr-reviewer: 5de8d94fa01098465f7d7586ecea97e0190ccb5d -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #573, which this PR is stacked on, lands; the base is already `main` and the trial merge with `upstream/main` is clean).

### What looks good
- Three-point plane math (`crates/app/src/pick/points.rs`): normal = (p2-p1) x (p3-p1), then flipped to the side away from the material (`material_side`). A tie (plane through the middle) falls back to the 1-2-3 right-hand normal, and the choice is surfaced to the user via `points_side` and the `outside` field of the MCP result. Flip behaves as in the face row.
- Refused by name before any write, with no unwrap/expect/panic: not exactly three picks, a face or edge pick, a point off the part or gone, no model, coincident points (<0.001 mm), near-collinear points (height < sin 1° x longest side, `points.rs` ~L122-130), non-finite results. The 3-2-1 frame proves its landings (1->2 on the axis, point 1 at the origin) and refuses instead of storing an off frame.
- One apply path: the face lay's core is now the shared `lay_datum` (`pick/plane.rs`), so a face and three of its corners cannot disagree (pinned by a test over every flip/place combination).
- One undoable command: `AlignPartToSetup::lay_on_points` / `check_points` (`commands/setup_align.rs`) go through the existing `new`, so undo/redo, stale ops, stock refit and linked setups follow the existing face-lay behaviour. The work offset is untouched.
- MCP `lay_part_on_points` (`mcp/align_tools.rs`) goes through the same command and history; enum/bool args are validated by name.
- UI tests drive real clicks (`setup_points_tests`, `points_vertex_pick` with three real viewport clicks), ending in Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y. Structural assertions were extended; no snapshot PNGs, goldens, CHANGELOG, build.rs, scripts, .github or dependencies are touched. Decision record is present. Provenance line is present.

### Local results (merged with upstream/main, debug)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | ok |
| points_align | 8 passed |
| plane_align / plane_align_edges / winding_align | 8 / 5 / 9 passed |
| axis_align / wcs_align | 10 / 5 passed |
| commands_undo / project_roundtrip | 32 / 69 passed |
| mcp_setup / setup_align | 5 / 9 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 384 passed, 1 failed (environmental) |
| clippy app + ui, `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds ... FAILED
egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found
```
That failure is the known no-GPU-adapter environment red on this machine, not a regression.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is about 3985 lines and grew by ~61 here; it was already far past the ~400-line guideline, so please split it along a domain seam in a later pass.
- The non-finite-vertex refusal has no test (the author notes no importer can produce one). Fine.
- Points can only be model corners until a pick carries a hit point (deferred by the author, recorded).
- Merge order: #573 first (it carries commits that are in this PR's history).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9e9104cbd4d3480bcc2b0d4cc77f066c6a9205ae -->
**Delta review** of the merge-of-main since my last review at `5de8d94`. Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What changed since `5de8d94`:** only merge-of-main commits (head `9e9104c` is the author's "Merge main into issue/555-three-point-plane"; the rest are main's own PR merges). No new own code.

**Checked**
- The conflict resolution keeps both sides: `pick.rs` exports (main's `pick_coords` plus this PR's `points` exports), `pick/axis.rs` (`point` made `pub(super)` for the points module), `axis_pick.rs::disarm_hidden` (the three-points draft joins #664's page-shown law), `setup_points_pick.rs` (marks `setup_pick_rows`), `plane_pick::arm` (main's `pause` kept, `points_pick` dropped), `tests.rs` (both mods listed).
- `gh pr diff --name-only` lists only the PR's own files (pick, setup_align, mcp align_tools, ui points/plane pick, tests, decision file). No posting.rs, no .cps, no goldens, no snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG or RECOMMENDED edits. The head already contains current main (`4827fde`), so the trial merge was a no-op.

**Results (head, own worktree and target)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test plane_align --test points_align --test plane_align_edges --test mcp_setup`: 5 / 8 / 5 / 8 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- plane setup points` (from `crates/ui`): 70 passed.
- `cargo clippy -D warnings` on the app and ui libs plus the three touched suites: clean.

**Note for the maintainer (not this PR):** `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets` fails on current main (`4827fde`) in `crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs:83`: `error[E0063]: missing field 'hand' in initializer of OpParams`. The file is identical to main's and this PR does not touch it; a fix on main is owed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
